title: Crisis detector, English
notes: TIER IS watch, NOT gate, and the floors are the design's targets rather than today's numbers. The detector has no patterns for the firearms, hanging or jumping means families (.claude/MEMORY.md names this the largest remaining crisis-coverage gap), so recall measures ~0.72 against a 0.98 floor. Lowering the floor to make it pass would be exactly the grader relaxation PR #137 forbids; per-family recall in details.recallByFamily shows which families are at zero. Flip tier to gate in the PR that adds those families and shows the floor met.
